ai_review.summary: Fine fall‑tour show with nice audience sound
ai_review.review: Reviewers describe this concert as one of the best from the fall tour, highlighting a solid performance and pleasant audio quality. The recording is an audience source that sounds clear enough to enjoy, though no detailed technical notes are provided.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief positive review (4 stars) mentioning good sound and a strong show; limited data leads to a modest rating with low confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes "Nice sound too" indicating satisfactory clarity for an audience recording; no specific issues mentioned.
